mines.mine_notes: royalty: 2.0% NSR on the Ermitaño mine and surrounding area of interest; operator First Majestic Silver Corp.; part of the Santa Elena complex, Sonora, Mexico; producing since Q4 2021. FY2025 mine-level: 1,101,613 t processed averaging 62 g/t Ag and 2.65 g/t Au, producing 88,107 oz Au and 1.42 Moz Ag; recoveries averaged 65% Ag / 94% Au. Dec 31, 2025 mine-level reserves: 4,310 kt at 35 g/t Ag and 1.37 g/t Au = 4,790 koz Ag / 190 koz Au; M&I 8,880 koz Ag / 380 koz Au; Inferred 24,190 koz Ag / 670 koz Au, including the Navidad vein (discovered Jul 2024, within the royalty AOI). FY2025 royalty revenue C$9,600,669, all from Ermitaño (+21% y/y). Attributable ounces not disclosed; ownership_pct shown is the NSR royalty rate.

SOLD: Orogen's 1.0% NSR royalty on the Arthur Gold Project (formerly Expanded Silicon; operator AngloGold Ashanti NA) was acquired by Triple Flag Precious Metals through the plan of arrangement that closed Jul 9, 2025 (total consideration ~C$421M for 201,961,675 shares of the predecessor). No longer in the portfolio; listed here for continuity.

GROUPED: early-stage project-generation NSR royalties in Mexico. Cuale 0.5% (Rockstar Resources); Cumaro 1.0% (Heliostar Metals); Cumobabi 1.5% (First Majestic Silver); La Lola 2.0% (Heliostar Metals); Llano del Nogal 1.0% (Fresnillo; 1.0-1.5% underlying royalty to Altius); Sarape 2.0% (Advance Lithium). Los Coyotes (Sonora; Au, Ag): 100% of the project sold to Fresnillo plc on Aug 5, 2025 for US$118,000 on signing plus US$1.0M on commercial production; Orogen retained a 2.5% NSR, of which 1.5% can be repurchased by Fresnillo for US$1.5M.

GROUPED: early-stage project-generation NSR royalties in Nevada. Callaghan 0.5-1.0% (Black Mammoth Metals); Celts 1.5% (Eminent Gold); Cuprite 1.5% (Strikepoint Gold); Ecru 2.0% (Quebec Nickel); Firenze 1.5% (Altitude Resources); Gilbert South 2.0% (Eminent Gold); Jake Creek 1.0% (Headwater Gold); Kalium Canyon 2.0-3.0% (Green Light Metals); Raven 0.5-1.0% (Black Mammoth Metals); Elba (Si2) 2.0% (K2 Gold); South Roberts 0.5-1.0% (Ivy Minerals); Spruce Mountain 0.5% (Conquest Nevada).

GROUPED: early-stage project-generation NSR royalties in Canada. Astro, NWT 1.0% (Rackla Metals); MPD South, BC 2.0% (Kodiak Copper); Ball Creek West, BC 1.0% (Kingfisher Metals); Camelot, BC 1.0% (Prospect Ridge Resources); Hank, BC 3.0% (Kingfisher Metals); Onjo, BC 2.0% (Pacific Ridge Exploration).

GROUPED: early-stage project-generation NSR royalties elsewhere. Lake Victoria Gold Fields, Kenya 3.0% (Saturn Resources); La Rica, Colombia 1.0% (MCC Mining); Argentina Royalties 1.0% (Magna Terra Minerals).

notes: Royalty/streamer + project generator, fiscal year ended Dec 31, 2025 (all amounts CAD; filed Apr 27, 2026). The 2025 reporting entity is the spin-out (formerly 1537944 BC Ltd.); on Jul 9, 2025 Triple Flag Precious Metals closed a plan of arrangement acquiring 201,961,675 shares of the predecessor (renamed Triple Flag Nevada Inc.) for ~C$421M, including Orogen's 1.0% NSR on the Arthur Gold Project. Altius Minerals holds 16.7% of the spin-out (9,889,490 shares). Common shares began trading on the TSX-V as OGN.V on Jul 11, 2025 and on the OTCQB as OGNNF on Jul 18, 2025. Head office: 1015-789 West Pender Street, Vancouver, BC, Canada V6C 1H2. FY2025: royalty revenue C$9,600,669 (100% from the 2% NSR on Ermitaño), prospect-generation revenue C$3,040,191, net income C$4,562,938, working capital $25.8M, no debt. Attributable gold/silver production not disclosed (royaltyco); mine-level Ermitaño output was 88,107 oz Au and 1.42 Moz Ag in 2025. ~29 exploration-stage project-generation royalties are GROUPED by region below (individual early-stage NSRs, operators and rates summarized in mine_notes). Generative alliances with Altius (Nevada), South32 and Triple Flag (Utah).
